Usage: st [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  ST: managed-project tools for agents.

  Discover: search "<query>" | tools manifest --surface <surface>. Task work:
  ready | claim <id> | context <id> | pulse --gate | check | commit -m MSG |
  done <id>. Task state: pause <id> | reopen <id> | cancel <id> | update <id>.
  Inspect: vcs doctor | service status | browser --help. Use `st <command>
  --help` for command-specific syntax. Global options precede the command.

Options:
  -P, --project TEXT            Project ID (overrides auto-detection)  [env
                                var: ST_PROJECT_ID]
  --human                       Indent JSON; requires --no-compact and no
                                --progress-only
  -c, --compact / --no-compact  Compact structured output; --no-compact
                                selects JSON where supported  [default:
                                compact]
  --progress-only               Progress summary only
  --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy
                                it or customize the installation.
  --help                        Show this message and exit.
